purpose: Diagnostic observability + solver/time-step sensitivity ONLY. No fix, no acceptance, no HOLD change.
api: lab.full(dir, stop, step, method) then lab.execute(dir, hypothesis, variable, timeout=180)
unmodified: circuit.cir from R1 baseline copied byte-for-byte; only .tran line and .save line replaced by lab.full(). All four vendor models copied from OLD/sim/s06c_current_cell_v3/ST_AUX12_1ns and hash-checked by lab.execute against BASE/preregister.json model_hashes.

predictions_and_falsifiers.global_peak: R1 global max I(DREC) magnitude is a +-2us event; runs are expected to reproduce the switching phase within a few 10s of ns, predicted global I(Drec) peak within 30% of R1.
predictions_and_falsifiers.kcl_ability: I(RSRC)+I(XQ:LS)+I(RF)-I(RGS)-I(RNEG) at node src. If LTspice rejects any of I(XQ:LD/LS/LG), I(XNEG:ddio/dgr) the run result is PRESERVED as failure; NOT retried.
predictions_and_falsifiers.solver_sensitivity: gear200 vs gear100 vs trap200 compared on the COMMON complete window only; peak change >5% or KCL residual >1mA is reported as a failure of the diagnostic reproducibility screen (per lab.preregister diagnostic_reproducibility), not as an electrical fail.
predictions_and_falsifiers.no_sign_flip_claimed: Phase may shift run-to-run; a peak shift is NOT evidence for or against diode recovery.

worker_status_semantics: PASS = evidence delivered only; electrical acceptance is NOT implied and remains HOLD.
